name: LEVIR-CD: A Large-Scale Remote Sensing Building Change Detection Dataset
description: LEVIR-CD is a large-scale, high-resolution remote sensing building change detection benchmark dataset introduced by the Image Processing Center at Beihang University. Containing 637 bi-temporal image patch pairs of size 1024x1024 pixels at 0.5-meter ground sample distance collected from Google Earth, the dataset spans 20 different regions across several cities in Texas, USA between 2002 and 2018. It annotates 31,333 individual building change instances (such as new building construction, demolition, and expansion) with pixel-level binary change masks while accounting for seasonal changes, lighting variations, and soil differences. The canonical benchmark partition comprises 445 training pairs, 64 validation pairs, and 128 testing pairs. LEVIR-CD and its related LEVIR-CD+ expansion are unified under this canonical dataset identity.

provenance.curation_notes: Annotated by remote sensing image interpretation experts to identify human-made structural building changes while disregarding natural seasonal surface variations. LEVIR-CD+ expanded this to 985 pairs; both share the same foundational lineage.
